lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2Zr2Ag4 (MnZrAg2) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and a 16-atom unit cell containing three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements with eight geometric neighbors per center atom: Ag is coordinated by four Ag, two Mn, and two Zr neighbors, while Mn and Zr each have eight Ag neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Ag polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ag–Mn and Ag–Zr polyhedra.
